feedback: Elon's confession follows the previously visible contradiction: an unpowered camera cannot support his claimed live private view. His access to the preview bottle and waiting glass already made the transfer route plausible, and the threat to expose his demonstration supplied motive. Calling the panel a saved image confirms what the sample-image record allowed us to infer; it does not introduce a new necessary clue. The confession's exact act of taking poison is new as an admission, not as evidence required to identify him. His shame about presenting unfinished work coheres with his earlier funding anxiety. Barb and Chip's consequences give the ending some emotional range, though their concise resolutions feel quite tidy. Overall the reveal is earned and understandable.
